environment.network_note: pine check performs its own Node-side fetch to pine-facade.tradingview.com. Inside the file sandbox that fails with {"success":false,"error":"fetch failed"} (records check-lib, check-typeerr) - environment, not product. The escalated re-runs are the records referenced here.

steps: pine set library-v1 -> pine save = v1.0 saved_with_dialog
pine set library-v2 (+scale) -> pine save = v2.0
pine set library-v2 (identifier-safe title) -> pine save = v3.0
pine open by name -> pine get (hash matches fixture)

library-v1.pine.role: v1 function contract without scale; current file has corrected identifier title, original spaced-title run is retained in raw evidence

library-v2.pine.role: FINAL keeper: weighted_score(..., float scale = 1.0), identifier-safe title

library-type-error.pine.role: negative control: clamped + "px" and clamp(hi, lo, "wide")

verifier-indicator.pine.role: independent verifier, 33 literal probes, copy region equals the FINAL library-v2 body

raw/verifier-spliced.pine (ignored).role: body-mismatch variant built from a tampered library source; the detector flagged it and the chart update was rejected

body_identity.method: Library body region between CLIQAS05-BODY-BEGIN/END (export stripped, function name normalized to FN) versus the verifier copy region between CLIQAS05-VERIFY-COPY-BEGIN/END (name normalized the same way). Name normalization is allowed because the verifier cannot import and therefore renames.

detector_sensitivity_negative_control.note: Final-v2 comparison detects exactly one changed line: the math.max function token changed to math.min inside clamp.

server_checks.result: compiled false, 2 errors with exact line/column and argument name

verifier.json: has_errors true: Cannot call "addProbe" with "na" as a value for a non-typified argument (fixture fixed afterwards)
unchanged true (study already carried the matching applied version)
compiled true, saved true, button_clicked updateOnChart -> v5.0
save ok (v9.0) then chart update Rejected; pine errors 0, console shows only open/save/compile messages, study stayed status 2 running the previous version
indicator remove of the old study (own QA asset)
compiled true, button_clicked addToChart -> study 3IwshQ, status 2, pineVersion 9.0

library.json: has_errors true, 1 error: library title with spaces rejected (line 5 col 9)
translation passed; then Applied indicator calculation did not finish before timeout (study utwwmx left at status 0)
same timeout after re-save to v3.0

library_chart_add.scope_note: Library import integration is out of scope for S05. No import-based verification was performed and none is claimed.

attempts_in_order.outcome: diagnostic only: 1 error, invalid library title
translation OK; Desktop attached the library as study utwwmx; the study never calculated (runtime status 0, no error text); pine compile reported a ~30 s timeout
identical timeout and identical status-0 study

library_chart_add.observed_result: A library can be attached to the chart as a study but its application cannot be verified by pine compile: 2/2 valid-title attempts timed out at ~30 s and the added study stayed at runtime status 0.
library_chart_add.causal_status: HYPOTHESIS, not established: a library computes no series, so the applied calculation never reports completion. The evidence recorded here is only (a) the library study existed with status 0 and (b) pine compile timed out. No platform-level cause was proven, and no other indicator was studied for comparison beyond one state probe.

related_state_probe.what: diagnostic indicator add on the same chart at that moment
related_state_probe.result: new_study_count 0 (no study created) - recorded as chart-state context only, not as a library finding and not investigated further

library_chart_add.cleanup: indicator remove utwwmx; the final chart carries Volume and the CLIQA S05 verifier study only.

calculation_cross_check.final_fixture_relation: The verifier copy region now equals the FINAL library-v2 body (name-normalized, export stripped), so the on-chart numbers and the library keeper source are aligned by construction plus the body-identity check.

limits: Library import integration was NOT verified (out of scope): no importing script exists and no import behaviour is claimed.
